use_case: Notes, online classes, papers, research; carries laptop around campus
hard_requirements: Prefer 16GB RAM; prefer 512GB SSD; comfortable keyboard; strong battery life
preference_rule: Prefer the option with the best evidenced battery life and portability among options that meet the shopper's needs; do not reward raw performance if battery/portability is poor
required_listing_evidence: Price and currency; RAM; SSD; keyboard evidence; battery test or disclosed capacity/runtime; weight

use_case: Minecraft, Fortnite, Roblox plus schoolwork and browsing
hard_requirements: Dedicated GPU; adequate cooling; high-refresh display
preference_rule: Prefer the strongest supported gaming performance and cooling; weight is secondary
required_listing_evidence: Price and currency; GPU model/VRAM; game benchmarks or comparable GPU evidence; cooling reviews/tests; refresh rate; RAM; weight

use_case: Orders, customer communication, spreadsheets, video meetings
hard_requirements: Good webcam; reliable Wi-Fi; at least 16GB RAM; capable office/video-meeting processor; full-workday battery desired
preference_rule: Prefer supported reliability and security evidence; then multitasking capability; do not infer durability/security from branding alone
required_listing_evidence: Price and currency; RAM; CPU; webcam; Wi-Fi standard; battery test; warranty; repair/reliability evidence; security support

use_case: Edit photos, organize large photo collections, occasional video editing

preference_rule: Prefer verified display accuracy and adequate editing performance/storage; lower price alone does not win
required_listing_evidence: Price and currency; display gamut/accuracy test; RAM; storage; CPU/GPU model and relevant benchmarks

shopper_profile: Parent buying for a family of four
use_case: Homework, movies, household documents, video calls, casual entertainment
